# Implementing a Lock-Free Work-Stealing Scheduler in Swift

## Introduction

A work-stealing scheduler is a sophisticated concurrent programming technique that enables efficient load balancing across multiple worker threads. The core idea is simple yet powerful: each worker thread maintains its own deque of tasks, and when a worker runs out of local work, it can "steal" tasks from the deques of other workers. This approach provides excellent scalability and minimizes contention between threads.

In this comprehensive tutorial, we'll implement a complete lock-free work-stealing scheduler in Swift, covering all the essential components and their intricate details.
